architecture: Original learned-position, non-ALiBi MPT decoder; included compatibility code required.

repair.objective: mean of 8 ordinary causal reply CEs + weight*(positive reply CE + .25*relu(.2+positiveCE-negativeCE))
repair.matched: Same initial adapters, replay/auxiliary order and per-step dropout seed; both arms forward/backward auxiliary graphs.
repair.selection: Step0 eligible; ordinary validation token CE <=1.02*initial; minimize .8*ordinaryCE+.2*synthetic positive example-mean CE.
repair.checkpoint_selection_limit: Guard is a loss constraint, not a guarantee of contextual quality. No automatic default promotion.

quality: Latest candidate shown to user; promising selected renderer, not a certified deployment or project default.
